column1: # The forms' AcceptButtons (docs/specs/ui-refresh-plan.md section 3.6; package UI-4a, docs/port-notes/UI-4a.md): a UI.Button set as
# its form's AcceptButton draws as the default button (filled Accent). For gallery G-UI3 the owner confirms the ones whose name is not
# OK or Save (column check=owner); a rejected one goes on Button.cs's plain list. Stock buttons (RdlDesign, RdlViewer and others) keep
# the Windows look. ControlStateGallery.AcceptButtons_ListMatchesTheSource checks it; OPMS_UI_ACCEPT_BUTTONS_WRITE=1 writes it again.
